Fgpt_package.navigator module¶

class Fgpt_package.navigator.Navigator(subroutine_dir, module_tree, parsed_modules)[source]¶

Bases: object

Navigator class used to analyze Fortran code to find specific variables or subroutines within modules. It performs a breadth-first search to traverse module dependencies and checks for variable or subroutine declarations.

add_modules_to_queue()[source]¶

Add the modules referenced by USE statements in the current module to the queue for further analysis.

external_subroutine_finder(variable_name)[source]¶

Initialize the search for an external subroutine by setting the target variable name, adding the module to the visited set, and starting the search process.

Parameters:

variable_name (str) – The name of the external subroutine to search for.

find_external_subroutine_in_module()[source]¶

Search for an external subroutine within the current module. If the subroutine is found, it adds a use statement to the variable declarations.

find_var_in_child_modules(key='variable')[source]¶

Traverse child modules in the queue to find a variable or subroutine. Updates the module directory and tree as needed.

Parameters:

key (str) – Specifies whether to search for a ‘variable’ or ‘subroutine’.

find_variable_in_module()[source]¶

Search for the variable in the current module and update the relevant attributes. If the variable is found, it checks the type and allocates status, then stores the information.

variable_finder(variable_name)[source]¶

Initialize the search for a variable by setting the target variable name and starting the search process.

Parameters:

variable_name (str) – The name of the variable to search for.
